description: This Java class 'HtmlMenuWrapper' provides a wrapper for rendering HTML menus within the OFBiz framework. It manages menu initialization, rendering, context management, and error handling, integrating with OFBiz's model and utility classes.

classes.name: HtmlMenuWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for setting up and rendering HTML menus in OFBiz, handling context, rendering, and session management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with resource name, menu name, request, and response; loads menu model and sets up context.

methods.name: getMenuRenderer
methods.description: Returns a new instance of HtmlMenuRenderer for rendering the menu.

methods.name: renderMenuString
methods.description: Renders the menu to a string using the model and renderer.

methods.name: setIsError
methods.description: Sets the error state in the context.

methods.name: getIsError
methods.description: Retrieves the error state from the context.

methods.name: setMenuOverrideName
methods.description: Overrides the menu name in the context.

methods.name: putInContext
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the context.

methods.name: putInContext (overloaded)
methods.description: Adds a nested key-value pair within a menu item in the context.

methods.name: getFromContext
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the context by name.

methods.name: getFromContext (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a nested value from the context within a menu item.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the HTTP request object and updates the renderer.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the HTTP response object and updates the renderer.

methods.name: getMenuWrapper
methods.description: Static method to retrieve or create a menu wrapper instance, managing session caching and class instantiation.

methods.name: setParameters
methods.description: Sets request parameters into the context.
